hub.search: Filters the scripts by their name, their technical name like w_stables, or a word from their description. Changes nothing.

filter.all: Shows every server script the admin panel can manage.
filter.panel: Shows scripts that have their own interface. Open it here with Open its own interface.
filter.commands: Shows scripts with quick commands you run from here instead of typing them in chat.
filter.settings: Shows scripts whose settings you change here; a change reaches every player without a restart.
filter.stopped: Shows scripts that are stopped now. Their features work for no player until someone starts them.

group.economy: Stores, money, crafting and smuggling: everything that brings money into the server or takes it out.
group.animals: Horses, wagons, pets and their shops.
group.world: The map, the weather and the places everyone sees in the world.
group.tribes: Tribes, kingdoms, jobs and their rules.
group.player: What concerns the player: their HUD, food, drink and XP.
group.fun: Games and entertainment inside the server.
group.system: The logs and the tools the server depends on to run.

hub.state: Whether the script runs now. Stopped means its feature works for nobody until someone starts it here or on the Resources page.
hub.version: The script version as its author wrote it. Useful when you report a problem and need to know which copy runs.
hub.overridden: How many settings of this script differ from their original value because staff changed them. Restore them on its settings page.

open.text: Closes the admin panel and opens the script's own interface. The server checks your permission first; press PgUp to come back.
open.undo: Opening it changes nothing; close it to come back

hub.openLocked: Locked because the script itself does not let you open its interface. The reason is written under the button; ask the owner if you need it.
hub.commandsBtn: Opens this script's quick commands in the side panel. Fill in the boxes and run them without typing anything in chat.
hub.settingsBtn: Opens the script settings you can change here. Changes apply to every player once saved, with no restart.
hub.details: Shows everything about the script in the side panel: what it does, how its interface opens and its quick commands.

start.text: Starts the stopped script. Its feature returns for players within seconds.
start.undo: Yes, stop it from the Resources page

hub.how: How a player or staff member opens this interface in the game without the admin panel, like a command typed in chat.

drawer.about: What this script does in the server and when you need it.
drawer.own: The script's own interface as it is. The admin panel only opens it; the script checks every permission inside it itself.
drawer.commands: The script's ready commands. Each runs in your name and is kept in the admin log, so type the values with care.
drawer.settings: The settings you can change from the admin panel, and how many of them differ from the original now.
drawer.resource: The script's state on the server, its technical name and its version.
drawer.name: The script's technical name on the server. You need it on the Resources page or when talking to the developer.

cmd.run: Runs the command now in your name with the values you typed. The script checks your permission itself, and the command is kept in the admin log.

runDanger.text: Runs a command that changes something for the player that does not change back by itself. We ask once more first so it never happens by mistake.
runDanger.undo: No, only with another command that sets it back

cmd.output: The script's answer to the last command you ran here. If it shows an error, read it, fix the values and try again.
cmd.online: The command needs the player in the game now. If they are away, wait for them to join or use the Characters page.

module.back: Takes you back to the list of all scripts. Your unsaved edits stay in the draft until you come back to this script.
module.history: Every change made to this script's settings: who made it, what the value was, what it became and when.
module.advanced: Settings you rarely need, with a big effect. Change them only if you know what they do.
module.readOnly: You can see the values but not change them, because this section needs a higher level than yours.
module.orphans: Saved values for settings the script no longer has. They are not applied and not deleted by themselves; the developer decides.
module.drift: The developer changed this setting's original value after you edited it. Your value is the one applied now.
module.keepMine: Keeps your value and hides this notice. Changes nothing on the server.

takeNew.text: Sets the setting back to the new original value the developer chose. It applies after you save.

module.review: Every change written as a plain sentence before it applies. Read them carefully, then save.
module.understand: An extra check for big changes. Turn it on once you understand the change reaches every player now.

save.text: Saves the changes and applies them to every player at once, with no restart; they are kept in the admin log in your name.
save.undo: Yes, change the value again or press Restore

module.rejected: Some changes were not saved. The reason is next to each one, and your edits are still in the draft.
module.invalid: A box holds a value outside the allowed range or is empty. Fix it before saving; the box is outlined.
module.reload: Fetches the saved values from the server now. Your unsaved edits stay in the draft.

table.search: Filters the rows by their name or the item's script name. Changes nothing.
table.family: Shows one family of items, like fruit or meat, so you can edit them together.
table.changed: Shows only rows with an unsaved edit or a value that differs from the original.
table.readOnly: Information about the item, for viewing only. It cannot be changed here because it is part of how the script is built.
table.item: The item name, with its script name under it. A locked row cannot be edited; the reason is written under it.

rowReset.text: Sets every cell of this row back to its original value. It applies after you save.

history.who: Which staff member made the change.
history.change: The value before and after the change. Original means it went back to the original value.

builtin.whud: Draws the player HUD and runs hunger and thirst. Change their speed, their damage and what shows on screen here; its own F7 panel stays as it is.

hub.search: Find a script by name or description…
hub.editNeeds: Changing needs level %s; you can view the values
hub.appliesAll: Every player, as soon as you save
hub.appliesRestart: Every player, after the script restarts
hub.emptyNone: The script list did not arrive from the server.
hub.loadError: Could not load the script list
hub.saved: Settings saved and applied to everyone

drawer.noPanel: This script has no interface of its own, so you manage it with the quick commands or the settings here.
drawer.settingsInfo: %s sections · %s values changed from the original
drawer.noSettings: It has no settings you can change from the admin panel yet.
drawer.name: Technical name

cmd.fillRequired: Fill in the required boxes first
cmd.offline: The player is not in the game now

module.orphans: Saved values for settings that no longer exist
module.drift: The developer changed the original from %s to %s after your edit
module.notFound: This script was not found or has no settings.
module.builtinNote: These settings are saved through w_hud itself, like its F7 panel, and reach everyone at once.
module.noHudCfg: w_hud's settings have not arrived from the server yet. Press Reload the values; if they still do not come, check that w_hud is running.

review.title: Check the changes before saving
review.lead: These changes will apply to every player now:
review.understand: I understand, apply them to everyone now

reject.stale: Someone else changed the value before you saved. We reloaded the values; check them and save again
reject.no_access: Your level does not allow this setting

invalid.empty: The box is empty; type a number
invalid.pattern: Wrong format; see the example in ?

derived.drain: With these numbers the bar empties from 100 to 0 in about %s
derived.never: With this value it never drops
derived.death: From the first damage to death: about %s
derived.noKill: and killing is off, so health stops just above death
derived.off: Damage is off, so hunger and thirst hurt nobody

history.empty: No change has been made to this script's settings yet.

whud.label: HUD and food
whud.description: Health, stamina, hunger and thirst rings, and how fast hunger and thirst drop and hurt.
